hints.title: Canonical Shift Normalization
hints.text: Normalize each word by shifting its first character to 'a' and rotating all other characters by the same offset modulo 26.

hints.title: Equivalent Cipher Classes
hints.text: Two words are Caesar ciphers of each other if and only if their normalized forms are identical.

hints.title: Count Combinations per Class
hints.text: Group words by their normalized canonical representation. A group of size m yields m * (m - 1) // 2 pairs.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here n is the number of words and L is word length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise comparison of all words with 26 possible rotations takes O(n^2 * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map stores normalized canonical words.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects canonical normalization by shifting first character to 'a'.
